text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
I can't believe I didn't even place!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you have one second to explain
the
reason for these results!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I suppose there's no other
explanation. My
abilities are beyond
reproach, after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But luck is something the strong make
for
themselves!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not strong enough to make my own
luck yet,
then I simply need to train
more.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I give you the right to elevate
my luck
and strength to the peaks of
perfection!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll accept nothing less than your utmost
effort!
Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
F-fine... I really hate to admit it...
and by that I
mean I absolutely loathe the idea,
but I'll accept
it... for now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, this means that I
have even
greater heights to reach if I
truly apply myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be able to fly to those heights
on my
wings of innate talent!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
With wings this powerful, I only require
diligent
practice to soar to the pinnacle
of perfection!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I am King Halo, and I will
never give
up!
